item.title: Tokushima Food Guide: Ramen, Sudachi, Naruto Sea Bream, and Mountain Fare
item.description: Tokushima sits at the intersection of several distinct food cultures: the coastal cuisine of the Naruto Strait, where powerful tidal currents produce some of Japan’s most prized fish; the mountain food traditions of the Iya Valley, where buckwheat, freshwater fish, and wild vegetables have sustained remote communities for centuries; and the rich, assertive ramen culture of Tokushima City itself. For overseas visitors with only a few days in the prefecture, this guide maps the essential dishes and the best places to find them.
